context: Request: list antitrust-practice matters where a deal went through a second request to clearance, with the clearance documents. Rubric names 1041-00001 (Solara Digital / Pinnacle Cloud) and its post-clearance-status memo; 1003-00003 is also tolerated.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read of the store folder (rejected as a directory); the listing showed files from only a few matter folders.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: One content grep restricted to .docx files returned no matches; the parallel glob repeated the same short listing.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches of reads of memos and agreements from the two matters at the top of the listing; no keyword lead behind the choice.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that no matter in the store meets the request, discussing only the two matters it read.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Read documents picked from the file listing → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its only keyword search returned nothing; it fell back to the matters visible in the short listing and concluded none qualified.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: The only keyword search was a .docx-restricted content grep that returned nothing, and the agent neither retried with other file types nor searched file names, so the matter it needed never surfaced.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel whole-store glob and a content grep for request keywords; the grep hits (mostly emails) drive the next step.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads six emails from two matters that the grep returned.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of one candidate matter.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Globs for file names containing request keywords and for a practice-area subfolder name.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the folders of four candidate matters found by the name search.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads closing / strategy memos and a status tracker across three candidate matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads four submission documents from the matter it later picked.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the response naming one transaction split across two matter folders.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Globs to check a cited file path, then edits the path in the response.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find over the whole store, first 200 files.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Two find | grep passes over file paths for request keywords.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the opening of a strategy memo from each of six candidate matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of five candidate matters in one shell loop.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads closing / status documents from three candidates; two guessed paths do not exist.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads more of a status tracker in one of the two matters it picked.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the response naming two matters.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run

divergence: Passing runs (T1, T2) searched file names for request keywords (glob / find | grep), which surfaced the needed matter's folder, then opened its closing memo. T0's only keyword search was a .docx-only content grep that returned nothing; it read the two matters at the top of the short listing and concluded none qualified (fails both matter criteria).
